info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

parcels.desc: Parcel is located in an area that is several thousand acres of mostly pulpwood lots. The roads are gated and many are private. Legal access is questionable, let alone physical access. The trail into this area was washed out this spring. There is no utility service anywhere near this parcel. If you've got a helicopter, this is the one for you. 660' x 660' in size.

Parcel does not have any apparent road or trail to access it. Sits a hundred feet or so west of US 41 in Limestone Township, north of Trenary. Measures 747' (E-W) x 369' (N-S) = 6.3 acres. The east half of the parcel is marshlands according to USGS topo maps. Appears to be densely wooded.

This is a great property ! 46.3 acres of nicely wooded property, a modern home with 3 car garage and a great storage barn to boot ! We believe this is a manufactured home based on the steel floor framing. Wonderfully executed 3 BR 2 BA design with gas fireplace. Full basement with 8' poured sidewalls.3 car attached garage. Onsuite master bath with jetted tub. The latest dated item we saw in here w...

This sale includes two adjacent parcels with 200' total on the Sand River. Each parcel is about 1/3 acre in size, but that number include land that is underneath the river, as property ownership is to the centerline of rivers in Michigan. Older 1.5 story wood frame home in Munising. Corner lot. Older roof looks a little worn and could use a refresh soon (if not already leaking). This home was still in the process of being vacated when we were there in early June, so we couldn't get a view of the interior. There is personal property here that is not included in the sale, and a vehicle is parked on the front lawn. It appears the home...

The subject property is in Rock River Township and consists of a strip of land 200 ft wide with Black Creek flowing through the center of it. The parcel is located south of E Cold Springs Road, east of the M67 intersection, about 3 miles south of Chatham, MI. The property is surrounded by 2 private landowners and does not have legal road access to E Cold Springs Road (i.e., landlocked). A private ...
~10 acre square, ~8 miles south of Coalwood. No known road access or easements. Good purchase for a neighboring property owner.

Parcel fronts about 660' along the north side on M-28, just a few miles west of Christmas. It's about 45 minutes to Marquette from here. The property is nicely wooded with a nice variety that includes some hardwoods. Topographical maps indicate that the rear portion of the property may be marshy, but we found no trails back there to examine it in person during our visit. There is a collapsed mobil...

Small 60' x 80' parcel is located on the South side of Airport Road, just east of M-77. There are wood survey flags at the two roadfront corners, and the lot is easily distinguished because it is wooded, and the land around all three sides of it is wide open and mowed. You will want to check zoning to see if this is large enough to build on, if that is your concept.. Level uplands here.

Parcel sits west of Trenary Avenue. There appears to be a privately owned parcel between the subject parcel and Trenary Ave. There is a two track trail in/along the east end of the parcel, which appears to run north to S First St. We have no knowledge of any easements; interested bidders would be wise to look into access rights. Modern 2BR/1BA woodframe home with attached oversized steel garage and workshop on 30 country acres. This one looks like they just got up and left. Pretty clean inside, and mostly still furnished (see notes), but cluttered. Once you sort it out and do a little light cleaning, you should be able to move right in. Solid, straight buildings here. 40' foot wide (N-S) x 1320' foot (E-W) (1/4 mile) deep = 1.2-acre parcel that is adjacent to 4 private landowners. It's located east of the curve on Koski Road south of the M94 intersection about 3 miles west of Chatham MI.
